Flat 8, Pennywhistle House, 14 Sundial Row, London X12 4AB
2 bedrooms · 1 bathroom · 4th floor (lift) · Unfurnished

£2,350 per calendar month (£542 per week)

Description
A bright fourth-floor apartment in a well-run 2019 development, moments from the
park. The open-plan living area measures 68 sq m (732 sq ft) and both bedrooms
take a double bed. EPC rating B. Windows face south-east over the courtyard.

Key features
- Available from 1 November 2026, move-in date flexible by two weeks
- Minimum term 12 months, with a break clause at month six on two months' notice
- Bills included: water, heating and hot water via the building heat network;
  broadband is not included and council tax is payable by the tenant
- Deposit: five weeks' rent (£2,711). Holding deposit of one week's rent (£542)
  is payable to reserve the flat and comes off the first month's rent
- Concierge Monday to Friday, secure parcel room, residents' gym

Tenancy
The tenancy agreement is an assured shorthold tenancy. The landlord is Sundial Row
Residential Ltd. References are carried out by an external provider and a UK-based
guarantor may be required where income is below thirty times the monthly rent.

Agent
Marketed by a member of The Property Ombudsman redress scheme; client money
protection is provided through a recognised scheme. Viewings seven days a week.
